verification.simultaneousLoadScope: A shared-power stress case. Input ratios below one are expected when the finite plant cannot supply every requested system at once.
verification.allocationScope: Balanced cases share the normal source budget; priority cases retain the model reactor-mode output factor and report their actual available watts.
verification.thermalScope: Thirty seconds from cold undamaged start; design presets additionally report sustained heat transport. Current factory examples require strict cooling, zero integral or legacy sinks, and finite power for installed cooling equipment. Actual thrust always follows connected power.

generationMethods.scope: Only Imperial I and Imperial II are freshly constructed and published. The other 26 existing stock rows and all historical archives retain their original generating sources.

independentSurvey.obstacleScope: Physical nonflexible ship parts and engine bodies. The route generator also checks generated weapon and command compartments.
independentSurvey.terminalScope: The intended source and target host, associated engine body and original nozzle casing may contain their own connection. Exterior points require a verified bounded axial housing or a short structural-gap sleeve with two full physical-contact caps and a length bound tied to actual shaft/conductor radius and target engine/nozzle size. Electrical sleeves additionally require two distinct underlying physical support components.

independentConduitSurvey.scope: Conservative finite-cylinder proximity survey with tight cylinder bounds. Shared-terminal exemptions require the full sampled cross-section (centre and 32 points on each of two radial rings) inside the actual retained solid; a centreline or large bounding sphere does not exempt external crossings.
